name: Scorched Spider Fang
summary: Across the Wetlands, Cave Stalkers and Leech Stalkers carry Scorched Spider Fangs. Furen Longbeard in Stormwind needs fifty to strengthen mail for Alliance warriors.

sections.title: A Dwarven Smith's Formula
sections.body: In Stormwind, blacksmith Furen Longbeard strengthens mail by unusual means. He needs fifty scorched fangs from the Wetlands' giant spiders. Their dense, venomous substance has toughened in the heat. Furen works it into the mail links as he tempers them.

sections.title: Stalkers of the Wetlands
sections.body: Cave Stalkers and Leech Stalkers bear the fangs Furen needs. They live in the Wetlands' sunken valleys and burrows, amid damp and rot. Their mandibles are hardened and scorched. Gathering fifty means venturing into deep hollows and facing the spiders in their swarms.

faq.q: What are Scorched Spider Fangs used for?
aliases: what do i do with scorched spider fangs
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard in Stormwind needs fifty Scorched Spider Fangs to forge durable chest armor for Alliance warriors. The work also calls for components from Stonetalon and Razorfen Kraul.

faq.q: Where can I find Scorched Spider Fangs?
aliases: which spiders drop scorched spider fang
where to farm scorched spider fangs
faq.answer: Cave Stalkers and Leech Stalkers in the Wetlands carry Scorched Spider Fangs. Search their damp burrows, hillsides and excavation caverns.

faq.q: Why does a blacksmith need so many spider fangs to make armor?
aliases: why does furen need spider fangs
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard uses unusual dwarven methods to strengthen mail. He treats its links with hardened fangs, phlogiston and beast horns.

faq.q: Can any adventurer collect and turn in these fangs?
aliases: is scorched spider fang warrior only
who can turn in scorched spider fangs
faq.answer: Anyone traveling through the Wetlands can kill the spiders and take their mandibles. Furen commissions the armor only for aspiring warriors seeking to earn fire-hardened mail.

angles.text: As a warrior, you face Furen Longbeard's trial: gathering fifty fangs. The work tests your endurance and provides the raw parts for your mail armor.
As a blacksmith, you can see how Furen uses scorched chitin and fangs in mail links, following rare dwarven armoring traditions beyond ordinary smelting.
